description: VN→ZH classifier over-generalization (件 family): Vietnamese learners default to 个, but clothing / matters / gifts (衣服/事/事情/礼物/行李/毛衣/衬衫) take 件. Rule zh-ge-to-jian rewrites 个 → 件 for a closed noun in that class.
fp_risk_note: Low risk. Rewrites 个 → 件 only before a closed clothing/matter/gift noun (衣服/事/事情/礼物/行李/毛衣/衬衫) after a number/demonstrative. Compounds where 事 is not the counted head (事业/事故/事实) are guarded by a tail lookahead.

positive.notes: 一个礼物 → 一件礼物.
那个衣服 → 那件衣服 (demonstrative).

negative.notes: 人 genuinely takes 个 — not in the map, must abstain.
事故 (accident) — 事 is not the counted head, the 故 tail lookahead guards it, must abstain.
